Course Structure
Module I : Introduction to AI, what to expect from AI, definition and
history, understanding the journey, applications, agents introduction
Module II : Trustworthy AI, need and significance, different aspects,
integration of these aspects in real life scenarios, understanding and
application of interpretability and explainability, understanding and
application of fairness and biasedness, understanding and application
of privacy and security
Module III : uninformed search (BFS, DFS, iterative deepening
search, bidirectional search), A* algorithm, adversarial search, hill
climbing
Module IV : Bayesian learning (introduction, uncertainity), bayesian
networks, MDP, HMM
Module V : Reinforcement learning, application and research study
oriented, including Explainability Metrics

evidence perceived so far and built-in knowledge.
